verdict.rationale: Maritime's own docs describe official TypeScript and Python SDKs with a dedicated SDK section covering a quickstart with idempotent `provision`, authentication scopes, messaging agents and webhooks, and the Files API is exposed through 'both SDKs'. The evidence is first-party only. missing for 10: SDK package names and install instructions, SDK API reference depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Give every one of your users their own agent with the TypeScript or Python SDK.
The Maritime Files API: eight endpoints and both SDKs to browse, upload, download, and edit an agent's disk over HTTP
provision is idempotent on it: it returns the existing agent if there is one, else creates a new one. Safe to call on every sign-in.
Send a message and wait for the reply. Sleeping agents wake automatically.
